name: Isekai Slave
source:
Isekai Slave Tells the story of a young man (Yuji) who gets into an accident and is suddenly reborn in another world. Yuji is a young man. his life is always suffering. when Yuji was always bullied in high school and when he was growing up, Yuji was married off by his parents to a woman. his wife who was forced to marry him also left him to go with another man.

But all that changed when Yuji had an accident and died. He was reborn in another world. The world was like a fantasy world or like a world in a game, where things like magic, fantasy creatures, and kingdoms were real.

Yuji was born a noble who was quite influential in the kingdom. At first, Yuji was not used to it because previously, Yuji was just a loser who always locks himself in his room.
Yuji's life is boring, but one day Yuji's guards catch two slaves who have run away from their master. One of the milf female slaves begs Yuji to save them. It can be seen, from the two slaves, that they seem to be mother and daughter. So what will Yuji do with the two slaves? Will they be in a circle of love between master and slave?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2366700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Isekai Slave》讲述年轻人Yuji遭遇事故，突然转生到异世界的故事。Yuji的人生一直充满痛苦。高中时，他总被欺凌，长大后，父母又为他安排了一场婚姻。被迫嫁给他的妻子，也离他而去，跟了另一个男人。

然而，Yuji意外身亡后，一切都变了。他转生到了另一个世界。那里仿佛奇幻故事或游戏中的国度，魔法、幻想生物与王国，都真实存在。

Yuji生为贵族，在王国中颇具影响力。起初，他很不习惯，毕竟过去的自己，只是个总将自己关在房里的失意者。
Yuji的生活十分无聊，可某天，卫兵抓住了两个逃离主人的奴隶。其中一位成熟女奴恳求Yuji救救她们。看起来，这两名奴隶似乎是一对母女。Yuji会如何对待她们？主人与奴隶之间，又会陷入爱情的纠葛吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2366700/]Steam[/url]]
